newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai textile industry aims for 10 pct growth.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai textile industry aims for 10 pct growth.

text.p: Shanghai's textile industry is aiming at 10 percent growth in export earnings and sales in 1997, having recorded a thin profit of 10 million yuan in 1996, the Business News on Wednesday.

The Shanghai-based newspaper said Shanghai's textile factories, many of them old and inefficient, had registered an overall loss from January to July 1996, but finally hit the target of moving into profit by the year-end.
It said the 1997 targets for the city's textile industry included export revenue of US$1.3 billion, up 10 percent on 1996, and sales of 25 billion yuan, also up 10 percent on 1996.
